## Review

<!-- Tick what was actually done; the check derives your Human-Review and AI-Review levels
     from the ticks. Human review levels build on each other; for the AI review, tick every
     check that happened, and the highest one counts. See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

Human review (at least H0 is required):
- [ ] **H0** I checked the result as a whole: it does what was asked, runs, and the output is plausible
- [ ] **H1** I ran the tests or reproduced the key results myself, and read the important parts
- [ ] **H2** I read every changed line, understand it, and checked edge cases
- [ ] **H3** I validated it independently: new tests, a reference solution or method, or a second person's review

AI review (leave all unticked for A0; AI-written changes need at least A1):
- [ ] **A1** The AI that wrote the change checked its own work: it ran the tests and reviewed the result (not for human-written changes, G0)
- [ ] **A2** A new AI session, without the generating conversation, reviewed the final change and ran the tests
- [ ] **A3** A different model of similar or higher capability reviewed it extensively or benchmarked it: new tests, reference methods or solutions
